description: This file provides inline helper functions for managing PUCCH resource indices within a 3GPP-based wireless communication system, specifically for resource set and resource ID calculations.

methods.name: get_pucch_res_set_0_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a resource in resource set 0 based on resource set config ID and resource index.

methods.name: get_pucch_res_set_1_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a resource in resource set 1 based on resource set config ID and resource index.

methods.name: get_pucch_sr_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a PUCCH resource for SR in the cell resource list.

methods.name: get_pucch_csi_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a PUCCH resource for CSI in the cell resource list.
